question: The autobiography 'Wings of Fire' chronicles the life of which notable Indian personality?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**APJ Abdul Kalam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The book **'Wings of Fire'** is an autobiography of **Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam**, one of the most notable Indian scientists and the 11th **President of India**.
 
• It details Dr. Kalam's journey from a humble beginning in a small town called **Rameswaram, Tamil Nadu**, to becoming the **'Missile Man of India'**.
